title: Deterministic rubric grader
acceptance: A new expected kind checks free text against a rubric: required and forbidden terms, Italian-language share, length bounds, register markers
Same input always gives the same verdict; contract tests and PROTOCOL.md describe it
privacy: Neutral invented cases and fixtures only; no consumer data, private reports or credentials in Git.
validation: Failing pack test first; fixture for each acceptance item; npm test; npm run check:index; CI
escalation: No knowledge of any consumer; a consumer-specific need goes to that consumer's backlog
Material scope or effort growth goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Implemented 2026-11-25: src/rubric.ts, pack validation, run grading, catalog label, contract tests and PROTOCOL.md; CI and merge remain. Not a measurement.
